meta_title: Mango — A fast, native MongoDB GUI
meta_description: Mango is a native MongoDB client built with Perry. No Electron, no JVM — just a fast, lightweight binary that talks directly to your database.
og_title: Mango — A fast, native MongoDB GUI
og_description: No Electron, no JVM — just a fast, lightweight binary that talks directly to your database.
hero_subtitle: A native MongoDB GUI that starts instantly and stays out of your way. Built with Perry, compiled to a single binary.
features_subtitle: Browse, query, and manage your MongoDB databases with a clean native interface.
feature_connections_desc: Save and organize connection profiles. Supports host/port, connection strings, SCRAM-SHA-256, and TLS.
feature_query_desc: Write filters, sort, and project with instant results. Query any collection with the full power of MongoDB's query language.
feature_editing_desc: View, edit, insert, delete, and duplicate documents inline. Changes are saved directly to MongoDB.
feature_browser_desc: Navigate databases and collections with stats at a glance. See document counts, storage size, and index info.
feature_indexes_desc: List all indexes with their keys, uniqueness constraints, and sizes. Understand your data access patterns.
feature_theme_desc: Follows your system appearance automatically. A warm cream palette in light mode, deep charcoal in dark.
built_subtitle: Mango compiles TypeScript to native machine code using Perry. No web views, no garbage collection, no runtime bloat.
platforms_subtitle: One codebase, native performance on every platform.
cta_subtitle: Open source, free forever. Download the binary or build from source.
footer_text: © 2026 Skelpo GmbH. Mango is open source under the MIT License.
cookie_text: We use cookies to analyze site traffic and improve your experience. By accepting, you agree to our use of analytics cookies.
